summary: Sales-readiness verification for guest checkout, POST checkout, plan-change, and regression suite. Ran existing unit tests (5/5 pass) and added a new end-to-end backend test module (10/10 pass) hitting the live preview backend. Verified GET /api/payments/checkout?plan= 303 to Stripe (monthly/annual) and 400 unknown_plan for weekly; POST checkout works guest and authenticated; admin POST binds a Stripe customer with metadata.app_user_email; _grant_from_session creates user + active membership from customer_details.email; monthly→annual plan switch supersedes and relabels; past_due keeps status active; _mark_cancelled stamps subscription_end_at + last_event='sub_deleted'. Regressions: /api/auth/me unauth returns both stripe_prices, /api/payments/portal unauth = 401, /api/stripe/webhook bad signature = 400. Frontend: /payment/success?session_id=<seeded-paid> renders the exact 'link' state — status='Payment received. Check your inbox.', payment-success-email shows the transaction's email, payment-success-resend disabled with label 'Not there yet? Resend available in a minute'. A magic_links row was created for the seed email by the /payment/success sendLink call (cleaned up). Real Stripe Checkout UI completion was NOT automated (out of scope for reliable Playwright); the equivalent DB flow was exercised via _grant_from_session/_sync_subscription.
critical_code_review_comments: stripe_payments.py:161-179 — get_status calls stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve synchronously inside the async handler; under load this will block the event loop. Consider asyncio.to_thread like sync_from_stripe_customer already does.

stripe_payments.py:117 — payment_transactions row is inserted for every /payments/checkout call including guest (email=null). Over time rate-limited/abandoned sessions will accumulate. Non-blocking, but consider a TTL index or a periodic cleanup for status='initiated' older than N days.

PaymentSuccessPage.jsx:47 — 1500ms setTimeout redirect on state='ok' fires even after component unmount check (`cancelled` flag doesn't cover this branch). Very minor race if user navigates away during redirect window.

PaymentSuccessPage.jsx:19 — 60s canResend timer only starts once state === 'link'; if state transitions ok→link (which doesn't currently happen), the 60s window would be re-armed. Fine for the current state machine.

success_rate.frontend: verified — /payment/success link state renders per spec

seed_data_creation: Inserted+deleted 1 paid payment_transactions row (cs_test_seed_6c105b4805 / seed-abe78c@example.com) to render the success 'link' state; deleted the auto-created magic_links row for the same email. Test_admin_post_binds_customer creates a Stripe test customer for admin (Stripe test-mode, harmless per instructions); admin.stripe_customer_id may be populated but no memberships row for admin was created. Deleted 8 initiated (unpaid) payment_transactions rows accumulated across test runs. Throwaway plan-change users are cleaned up inside the test itself.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full sales-flow regression is in /app/backend/tests/test_sales_e2e.py (10 tests) + test_sales_flow.py (5 tests). Runs against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Real Stripe Checkout UI end-to-end (typing card 4242… on Stripe's page) was NOT automated because Stripe's page geometry is unstable for Playwright; the equivalent /status→_grant_from_session path is covered by TestGuestGrant. If Stripe UI automation is ever needed, use Playwright + Stripe's test-mode selectors documented at https://stripe.com/docs/testing.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All acceptance criteria from the review request were verified either via HTTP against the live preview or via direct DB-level exercise of stripe_payments helpers.
